ustawienia.kat.osoby.opis: People, online account, who sees the results
ustawienia.kat.sterowanie.opis: Game profiles, control mode, control key
ustawienia.kat.bieznia.opis: Your treadmill, belt start and stop, simulator
ustawienia.kat.poziomy.opis: Achievement notifications over the game, sound
ustawienia.kat.wyglad.opis: Theme, colour, text size, window, on-screen button
ustawienia.kat.dane.opis: Data backup, moving to another computer
ustawienia.osoby.opis: Each person has their own game profiles, settings and step history.
ustawienia.osoby.wiersz: {liczba} {liczba, plural, one {game profile} other {game profiles}} · today {kroki} {kroki, plural, one {step} other {steps}} · account {pseudonim}
ustawienia.osoby.dodaj_z_kontem: Add a person with an online account
ustawienia.profile.opis: Control and colour are saved in the selected game profile.
ustawienia.profile.podsumowanie.pad: Gamepad · {liczba} {liczba, plural, one {gear} other {gears}} · up to {kmh} km/h
ustawienia.wyglad.kolor: Colour · saved in the game profile {profil}
ustawienia.sterowanie.aktywny: This mode works now. You can also choose another one and set it up for later.
ustawienia.sterowanie.nieaktywny: {tryb_aktywny} mode works now. These settings take effect after you switch to {tryb} mode.
ustawienia.chodzenie.klawisze_w_grze: Keys in the game: On / Trial mode
ustawienia.chodzenie.klawisze_w_grze_opi: Trial mode: the app shows what it would press, but the game gets nothing. Use it to check the thresholds without moving your character.
ustawienia.chodzenie.histereza: Running turns off {kmh} km/h below the threshold, so {klawisz_biegu} does not keep switching on and off.
ustawienia.chodzenie.szybkie_stop_opis: The character stops at once when the belt slows down sharply.
ustawienia.klawisze.bez: No key / Pace when you are not holding a key and after control is turned off.
ustawienia.klawisze.opis: The key you hold sets the belt speed. The game gets these keys too.
ustawienia.pad.brak: No gamepad found. Connect a DualSense, DualShock 4 or Xbox controller by cable or Bluetooth.
ustawienia.pad.drabinka_opis: Drag a circle to set how far the stick must tilt to start a gear. The triangle shows where the stick is now.
ustawienia.pad.odliczanie: After stopping, this treadmill starts again only after about {sekundy} s. Choose “Gear 1 pace” so the belt does not stop and the stick works at once.
ustawienia.trening.opis: Control the treadmill from the computer, without a game. {klawisz_wlaczania} starts and stops the belt, {klawisz_szybciej} and {klawisz_wolniej} change the level. You can also pick a level by clicking it on the main screen.
ustawienia.wlaczanie.opis: Click the button below and press a key or a combination, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F8. It also works during the game. Windows and overlay shortcuts (e.g. Alt+Tab, Shift+Tab) will not work.
ustawienia.wlaczanie.pad_naglowek: Or a gamepad button (DualSense, DualShock, Xbox)
ustawienia.wlaczanie.pad_czekam: Press a button on the gamepad…
ustawienia.wlaczanie.pad_podpowiedz: The gamepad button works like the control key, also during the game. Choose one the game does not use, e.g. the touchpad, Create or a stick press.
ustawienia.wlaczanie.pad_ostrzezenie: {przycisk_pada} is jump or action in many games. Better choose another button.
ustawienia.tempo.opis: In Training mode they change the level, with the simulator its speed. They also work during the game. Combinations are allowed, e.g. Ctrl+F7.
ustawienia.wlaczanie.zmiana_profilu: Change the game profile on the main screen
ustawienia.wlaczanie.zmiana_profilu_opis: Clicking the profile name opens the list of profiles. Works when there is more than one profile.
ustawienia.bieznia.opis:
{model}
Belt {min_kmh}–{max_kmh} km/h · start about {sekundy} s · firmware {wersja_bt}
ustawienia.bieznia.brak: No treadmill chosen. Click Find treadmill on the main screen.
ustawienia.bieznia.start_stop_opis: Turn it off if you start the belt only with the remote.
ustawienia.bieznia.symulator_przelacznik: Try it without a treadmill: {klawisz_szybciej} speeds up, {klawisz_wolniej} slows down. Simulator sessions give no XP and do not go to the online account.
ustawienia.bieznia.modele_podpowiedz: List of models, downloading new ones and adding a treadmill profile from a file
ustawienia.poziomy.wlacz_opis: They appear in the bottom right corner, also over the game. They do not interrupt the game: keys and clicks still go to the game.
ustawienia.poziomy.dzwiek_opis: A short sound for a new achievement or level-up.
ustawienia.wyglad.na_wierzchu_opis: The WalkLevel window does not hide under the game.
ustawienia.wyglad.na_wierzchu_blad: Could not keep the window on top.
ustawienia.wyglad.przycisk_opis: A small button over the game. A click turns control on and off, a right-click opens the WalkLevel window.
ustawienia.wyglad.zmiana_osoby: Switch person on the top bar
ustawienia.wyglad.zmiana_osoby_opis: The avatar on the top bar opens the list of people. It shows when there is more than one person.
ustawienia.dane.opis: Save people, game profiles and results to a file to keep a backup or move them to another computer.
ustawienia.dane.przywroc: Restore the data from before the last backup was loaded
ustawienia.dane.folder_podpowiedz: WalkLevel keeps people, profiles, history and settings here.
ustawienia.pomoc.logi_bt_opis: Records exactly what the app exchanges with the treadmill. Turn it on when the connection has problems, then send a report. Keys and game data are not recorded.
ustawienia.pomoc.nagrywanie_opis: Saves speed and steps to a file in the nagrania folder. Needed only when the author asks for it.
ustawienia.osoby.wiersz_bez_konta: {liczba} {liczba, plural, one {game profile} other {game profiles}} · today {kroki} {kroki, plural, one {step} other {steps}}
ustawienia.pad.blad.brak: There is no such gamepad gear.
ustawienia.pad.blad.progi: Gamepad gears: the first from 0%, each next at least 5 points further, at most 100%. Speed 0.5–12 km/h.
ustawienia.klawisze.bez_stoi: Let go of the key and the belt stops. Press it and the belt starts.
ustawienia.klawisze.bez_stoi_rozruch: Let go of the key and the belt stops. Press it and the belt starts (start-up about {sekundy} s).
ustawienia.klawisze.przytrzymanie_opis: The belt speeds up only after you hold the key for this many seconds, so a short click changes nothing. Letting go works at once. The game gets the keys without delay.
ustawienia.pomoc.podziekowania: Original idea and lead tester: Velczer
ustawienia.wyglad.panel_opis: A list of friends at the side of the window: who is walking now, what they play and how their level grows.
ustawienia.wyglad.panel_powiadom: Notify me when a friend starts walking
ustawienia.wyglad.panel_powiadom_opis: A short message in the WalkLevel window. Nothing shows over the game.
